name: The Intern of Christmas Present
source:
Pressie's faced many challenges in their tenure as an intern ghost of Christmas present, turning the hearts of many a Scrooge (and quite a few Grinches). Now they have one last trial to face before they can be promoted to a full-time holiday spectre, and it's their greatest challenge yet: Girl Dracula, sworn enemy of Christmas and adversary of all that is holly-jolly! Will they sway the daughter of darkness? Or will they be left facing a blood-red Christmas?

[From [url=https://air-gong.itch.io/the-intern-of-christmas-present]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
普雷西在担任圣诞礼物实习生幽灵期间面临着许多挑战，这让许多守财奴（以及不少格林奇）的心都变了。现在，在晋升为全职假日幽灵之前，他们要面对最后一项考验，这是他们迄今为止最大的挑战：德古拉女孩，圣诞节的死敌，所有欢乐的敌人！他们会动摇黑暗之女吗？或者他们会面临血红色的圣诞节吗？

[来自[url=https://air-gong.itch.io/the-intern-of-christmas-present]itch.io[/url]]
